description: HTTP presets for the File And Utility Azure Functions app (Python v2 Function App). Each preset is an HTTP action pre-shaped for one endpoint.

actions.title: Left Join JSON Arrays
actions.description: Left joins two JSON arrays on a primary key, preserving every record from the initial array and suffixing conflicting column names.

parameters.name: primary_key
parameters.description: Field present in both arrays to join on.

parameters.name: initial_json
parameters.description: Left-hand array. Every record is kept.

parameters.name: update_json
parameters.description: Right-hand array. Matching records are merged in.

actions.title: Upsert JSON Array
actions.description: Updates matching records in an array by primary key and appends records that do not yet exist.

actions.title: Aggregations
actions.description: Computes count, min, max, average, median and standard deviation over named columns of a JSON array. Accepts an array of arrays to aggregate several sets in one call.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Array of objects, or an array of arrays of objects.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Columns to take the minimum of.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Columns to take the maximum of.

parameters.name: med
parameters.description: Columns to take the median of.

parameters.name: stdev
parameters.description: Columns to take the standard deviation of.

actions.title: Regex Find and Replace
actions.description: Returns every regex match with its start and end index, and optionally the string after replacement. Power Automate has no native regex, so this covers a real gap.

parameters.name: replace_text
parameters.description: Replacement text. Omit to find only.

actions.title: Index Duplicates
actions.description: Adds an occurrence counter to each record so repeated values of a field become 1, 2, 3. Useful for de-duplicating or naming split files.

parameters.name: index_name
parameters.description: Name of the added counter field. Defaults to Index_<index_field>.

actions.title: HTML Fields to Plain Text
actions.description: Strips HTML from named fields across an array of records and returns the array with those fields converted to clean text.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Field names whose HTML should be flattened.

actions.title: Python Transform Array
actions.description: Applies a Python expression to every item of an array.
actions.unsafe: This endpoint runs your expression through Python eval() with no sandbox. Anyone who can call it can execute arbitrary code on the Function App. Only enable it on a function you control, and never expose the key.

actions.title: Python Filter Array
actions.description: Filters an array with a Python boolean expression. Returns { values: [...] }.
actions.unsafe: This endpoint runs your expression through Python eval() with no sandbox. Anyone who can call it can execute arbitrary code on the Function App. Only enable it on a function you control, and never expose the key.

parameters.name: filter_query
parameters.description: Python boolean expression over `item`, e.g. item['Amount'] >= 100

actions.title: For Each Lookup
actions.description: For every value in a loop array, returns the first matching record from a lookup array. Replaces a nested Apply to each with one call.
actions.unsafe: This endpoint runs your expression through Python eval() with no sandbox. Anyone who can call it can execute arbitrary code on the Function App. Only enable it on a function you control, and never expose the key.

parameters.name: loop_array
parameters.description: Values to look up, one result each.

actions.title: For Each Filter
actions.description: For every value in a loop array, returns all matching records from a source array. Replaces Apply to each wrapping Filter array.
actions.unsafe: This endpoint runs your expression through Python eval() with no sandbox. Anyone who can call it can execute arbitrary code on the Function App. Only enable it on a function you control, and never expose the key.

actions.title: CSV to JSON
actions.description: Parses a CSV string into a JSON array, with control over delimiter, line break, header row, skipped rows and type detection.

parameters.name: file_content
parameters.description: CSV text. Wrap a file in @{...} so it resolves to a string.

parameters.name: first_row_headers
parameters.description: YES to treat the first row as headers.

parameters.name: skip_top_rows
parameters.description: Rows to skip before the header.

parameters.name: skip_bottom_rows
parameters.description: Rows to drop from the end.

parameters.name: type_detect
parameters.description: YES to infer numbers and dates.

actions.title: JSON to Excel Table
actions.description: Writes a JSON array into a formatted Excel table. Omit file_content to create a new workbook, or supply one to add a sheet to an existing workbook.

parameters.name: file_content
parameters.description: Existing workbook to add the sheet to. Omit to create a new one.

parameters.name: numeric_columns
parameters.description: Columns to force to a numeric type.

actions.title: Excel to CSVs
actions.description: Converts every worksheet of a workbook into a separate CSV.

actions.title: Get Excel Sheet Data
actions.description: Reads one worksheet into JSON with row and column trimming, column selection, filtering, skip and top. Handles .xls as well as .xlsx.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Workbook. Note this endpoint uses `file`, not `file_content`.

parameters.name: skip_top_rows
parameters.description: Rows to skip from the top.

parameters.name: skip_bottom_rows
parameters.description: Rows to drop from the bottom.

parameters.name: skip_left_columns
parameters.description: Columns to skip from the left.

parameters.name: skip_right_columns
parameters.description: Columns to drop from the right.

parameters.name: select_columns
parameters.description: Comma separated column names to keep.

parameters.name: remove_columns
parameters.description: Comma separated column names to drop.

parameters.name: top_records_count
parameters.description: Maximum records to return. 0 for all.

actions.title: Get or Edit Excel Sheet Names
actions.description: Returns worksheet names, or renames them by index or by regex replacement.

actions.title: Append or Remove Excel Sheets
actions.description: Combines worksheets across workbooks. Use select to keep sheets, remove to drop them, and pass several workbooks to merge them into one.

parameters.name: file_content
parameters.description: One or more workbooks. Always an array for this endpoint.

actions.title: Merge PDFs
actions.description: Merges several PDFs into one, carrying form field values across.

actions.title: Split PDF
actions.description: Splits a PDF by explicit page numbers, by fixed chunk size, or at pages matching text or a regex. Supply exactly one of pages, split_chunks, split_text or split_regex.

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: Page numbers to split at, e.g. [2, 5].

parameters.name: split_text
parameters.description: Split before each page containing this text.

parameters.name: split_regex
parameters.description: Split before each page matching this pattern.

actions.title: Rotate PDF Pages
actions.description: Rotates specific pages by a given number of degrees.

actions.title: Replace Text in PDF
actions.description: Finds and replaces text in a PDF by literal string or regex, redrawing the affected spans.

parameters.name: search_regex
parameters.description: Pattern to find. Takes precedence over search_text.

actions.title: Extract PDF Elements
actions.description: Extracts text, blocks and document metadata from a PDF, with per-block coordinates.

actions.title: PDF to Images
actions.description: Renders every page of a PDF to a PNG at 2x zoom.

actions.title: Images to PDF
actions.description: Builds a PDF from an array of images, one page each.

parameters.name: fit_to_page
parameters.description: YES to scale each image to the page.

actions.title: Add Images to PDF
actions.description: Stamps images onto a PDF at explicit coordinates. Useful for signatures and logos.

parameters.name: image_boxes
parameters.description: Array of { coordinates: { x0, y0, x1, y1, page }, file_content }.

parameters.name: resize
parameters.description: Scale the image to the box.

actions.title: PDF to Word
actions.description: Converts a PDF to a .docx, preserving layout where it can.

actions.title: PDF to HTML
actions.description: Converts a PDF to HTML.

actions.title: Sharpen PDF Text for OCR
actions.description: Re-renders a PDF at a higher DPI to make text crisper before OCR.

actions.title: OCR Spatial Text Replica
actions.description: Turns Azure Document Intelligence analyzeResult output into a spatially laid out plain text replica, so an LLM sees the page the way a human does. Send the analyzeResult directly as the body.

actions.title: Word to HTML
actions.description: Converts a .docx to HTML via Mammoth, adding table gridlines.

actions.title: HTML to Word
actions.description: Builds a .docx from an HTML string.

actions.title: Merge Word Documents
actions.description: Merges .docx files into one, with control over which document's headers and footers survive.

actions.title: Split Word Document
actions.description: Splits a .docx at paragraphs matching text or a regex, with an offset to shift the cut point.

parameters.name: split_offset
parameters.description: Paragraphs to shift the split point by.

actions.title: Replace Text in Word
actions.description: Finds and replaces text in a .docx by literal string or regex, preserving run formatting.

parameters.name: search_regex
parameters.description: Pattern to find. Takes precedence over search_text.

actions.title: Extract Word Elements
actions.description: Extracts paragraphs, tables, headings and styles from a .docx as structured JSON.

actions.title: Extract Word XML
actions.description: Returns the raw document.xml of a .docx. Pair with Update Word XML to edit a document programmatically or with an LLM.

actions.title: Update Word XML
actions.description: Writes modified document.xml back into a .docx. The other half of Extract Word XML.

actions.title: HTML Tracked Changes
actions.description: Diffs two HTML strings and returns marked-up HTML showing insertions and deletions.

actions.title: MSG to HTML
actions.description: Parses an Outlook .msg file into subject, sender, recipients, timestamps, body HTML and attachments.

actions.title: Resize Image
actions.description: Resizes an image by explicit dimensions, a max bounding box, or a scale factor.

parameters.name: max_width
parameters.description: Bounding box width. Alternative to width/height.

parameters.name: max_height
parameters.description: Bounding box height. Alternative to width/height.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Scale factor, e.g. 0.5. Alternative to width/height.

actions.title: Compress Image or PDF
actions.description: Reduces file size of an image or PDF. text_pdf_to_jpg rasterises text PDFs for much larger savings at the cost of selectable text.

parameters.name: compression_rate
parameters.description: Quality between 0 and 1. Lower is smaller.

parameters.name: text_pdf_to_jpg
parameters.description: YES to rasterise text PDFs. Removes selectable text.

actions.title: Zip Files
actions.description: Packs an array of named files into a single zip archive.

actions.title: Unzip Files
actions.description: Expands a zip archive into an array of files with names and detected content types.
